title: Position Analysis in League of Legends
description: League of Legends is a highly competitive, role based game of teamwork. This project analyzes a dataset on the majority of League of Legends competitive matches in 2025 and explores predicting a player's distinct role on the team - based on their post game performance. This project involves the many stages of conducting a data analysis project.

title: Bikewatching!
description: An interative visualization of bike traffic in the Boston and Cambridge area!

title: The Deceptive Global Aggregate
description: Climate change is a real phenomenon that everyone has been exposed to, but the extent to which they have - may have been deceiving. Using climate change as the backdrop, this narrative visualization explores the implications of different design decisions in Visualization making and provides audiences an interactable experience through different design choices.
